kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*// bh+rūm̐ las rin chen bum pa ni// mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang*// bdud rtsi'i mtsho dbus pad nyi dang*// baṃ ro'i gdan la k+ṣa yig las/ khro bo yak+sha me dbal ni// smug nag tho ba lcags kyu 'dzin// rngam brjid khro bo'i cha byad can// dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan// de yi gnas gsum yi ge gsum// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la// 'khril te bum nang lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs// de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas bum chur gnyis med ro gcig gyur// oṃ karma yak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya sogs bzla/ dung chos kyi chu oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul/ lha thams cad chags pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig tu gyur par bsams/ zhes pa'ang 'gyur med rdo rjes so// //
